description: This file defines a concurrent actor `TranscriptsStore` that manages storing and retrieving transcript entries in a file, with a max limit of entries. It includes initialization code that loads existing entries from disk, an append method to add new transcripts while maintaining the limit, and a method to retrieve the latest transcripts. Additionally, it extends `String` with a private method for appending lines to a file.

classes.name: TranscriptsStore
classes.description: An actor responsible for managing transcript entries, persisting them to disk, and providing access to recent entries.

classes.name: String
classes.description: String extension providing a method to append a line to a file at a specified URL.

methods.name: init()
methods.description: Initializes the TranscriptsStore by creating the supporting directory and loading existing transcript entries from disk.

methods.name: append(text: String)
methods.description: Appends a new transcript entry, maintaining the maximum limit of entries, and writes the updated list to disk.

methods.name: latest() -> [String]
methods.description: Returns the latest transcript entries stored in memory.
